text.tspan: Mean income per year within the 9th decile (after tax), 1913 to 2024
The mean income per year within the 9th decile (tenth of the population). Income here is measured after taxes

Note: This data is measured in
international-$
at 2024 prices to account for inflation and differences in the cost of living between countries.
